subject: AcmeCloud — Procurement timeline, PO vs card, and MPA check-ins
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCloud - Procurement timeline & commercial path (recap + next steps)

Hi Olivia — great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of the call:
- Use case: AcmeCloud wants to use Redwood for customer-facing summarization and search (low-latency inference on dedicated instances).
- Key SLOs: 200ms median token latency, predictable monthly spend, and SOC2-compliant logs.
- Primary constraints: procurement path (PO vs card), legal review, security questionnaire, and internal marketplace interest.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm your preferred commercial path — PO (net terms) vs corporate card?
2) Are you interested in listing on the AWS/GCP marketplace later, or do you want to go direct first?
3) Can you share procurement/procurement-team contact and target PO issuance date (if PO)?

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MPA_v1.xlsx) to speed alignment — it includes a suggested timeline for legal -> security -> finance -> PO.

I'll loop in Marcus (legal) and Rachel (AM/security) on follow-ups. If you want, we can propose date windows for a procurement kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_MPA_v1.xlsx (MPA template, editable)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud - Procurement timeline & commercial path (recap + next steps)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. Helpful. Quick answers: 

1) Procurement path: We prefer a PO with net-30 terms for initial engagement. We can evaluate marketplace later, but procurement prefers direct PO first.
2) Procurement contacts: procurement@acmecloud.com (procurement team) and Tom Reyes (finance lead) — looping them in.
3) Estimated timeline: Legal review ~2 weeks (depending on redlines), security questionnaire ~1-2 weeks, finance to process PO after legal sign-off (another 3–5 business days).

Can you send the SOW and a redlined-friendly contract? Also uploading a quick RFI template with a few answers we prepared.

Olivia Chen
Head of Strategic Partnerships | AcmeCloud
olivia.chen@acmecloud.com

Attachment: Acme_RFI_answers.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud - Procurement timeline & commercial path (recap + next steps)

Thanks Olivia — appreciate the clarity. Looping Marcus (legal) and Rachel (AM/security) to align on the roadmap below. Proposed mutual action plan (high-level):

MPA (proposed milestones):
- Day 0: Discovery call & draft MPA exchanged (done)
- Day 1–3: Redwood to provide SOW + standard contract (we can provide a redline-ready doc)
- Day 4–12: Acme legal review (2 weeks, target) — Marcus to prioritize for quick turnaround on minor edits
- Day 8–16: Security questionnaire completion (parallel; Rachel will coordinate and provide answers)
- Day 13–17: Finance processing and PO issuance (target net-30 start after PO)

Target dates (example):
- Start legal review: Apr 12
- Security questionnaire kickoff: Apr 12
- Target PO issuance: Apr 26 (depends on legal security timing)

We can compress timelines if there are minimal legal redlines — Marcus, any concerns on the above cadence? Rachel, can you own the security kickoff and point me to any POC details you need from Acme?

I'll upload the SOW and a clean contract (redline-friendly) to the DocuSign link and HubSpot deal record.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (deal record)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?powerFormId=abcdef

Thanks — Marissa

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.com, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud - Procurement timeline & commercial path (recap + next steps)

Hi all — I can take point on Redwood's legal review. A few quick notes after a preliminary look at the standard agreement Marissa mentioned: 

- Estimated review time: 3 business days for non-substantive edits; 7–10 business days if Acme proposes material changes (indemnity, data residency, or liability caps).
- Flags: please confirm intended data residency and whether Acme requires any non-standard indemnity or IP carve-outs.
- If Acme can provide a list of must-have clauses up front, we can focus the review and speed things up.

I'll prioritize this once I have the SOW and the contract draft; please share any specific clauses you need considered.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud - Procurement timeline & commercial path (recap + next steps)

Hi Olivia — happy to own the security questionnaire and kickoff. Quick questions to set expectations: 
- POC for security: who should our security team coordinate with at Acme (name + email)?
- Do you require SOC2 evidence or an on-site assessment? We can provide our SOC2 report and an architecture diagram.

Proposed security milestones (parallel to legal):
- Day 0–2: Security kickoff and questionnaire exchange
- Day 3–10: Acme reviews answers; follow-up Qs as needed
- Day 11–14: Final sign-off / acceptance for procurement to proceed

Attachment: security-questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — Rachel Kim
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmecloud.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud - Procurement timeline & commercial path (recap + next steps)

Thanks team — that works for us. Security POC: Jenna Park (jenna.park@acmecloud.com). We do require SOC2; an architecture diagram and the SOC2 report will be sufficient for this engagement.

Confirming target PO issuance: Apr 26, assuming no material legal redlines. Procurement contact is procurement@acmecloud.com and Tom Reyes (tom.reyes@acmecloud.com) is our finance lead for processing the PO.

Let's plan a 30-minute procurement kickoff for Apr 13 to align on the MPA and ownership. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Olivia
